summary: National Steel Company (CSN) filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings release, reporting consolidated net revenue of R$11,306.2 million, COGS of R$8,375.2 million, gross profit of R$2,930.9 million with a 25.9% margin, and SG&A expenses of R$1,643.7 million. The release discusses routine operational and financial performance, including segment dynamics and cost trends, with no mention of mergers, acquisitions, tenders, restructurings, or strategic actions. This is a standard periodic earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event.
